race.comment: What a task they've set us to start the day! Connections of ASHINA (8) couldn't have hoped to see their charge in a race as winnable as this, but she's become a recidivist at going under as favourite and can't be relied on too heavily. Still, this looks her race. GOOD LORDY ME (5) is another who has demonstrated an aptitude to get into the minors without winning, including a second placing as fav two back. Comes through the same race as ASHINA and some ground to make up on her, but there is not a lot in the way of compelling other form in this. CALL ME FRANCIS (3) looks the one with some fitness to come and has been building this prep. CHARLIE MESSY HAIR (4) looks best-suited in jumps races these days, but has the flat talent to find a spot in the placings in a race of this quality. DEVOTED TO YOU (9) looked to be trending the right way after the placing two back, but didn't back it up last time out. That form is still probably good enough to feature.
